name: bank-desktop-root
description: Root scripts for Bank Manager desktop app (Electron + React + ASP.NET + SQLite)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix electron
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "API,React,Electron" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:5050/health && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "React,Electron" -c "green,yellow" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
